data.name: Combat Trick / Greater Shield Focus
data.description: When an attack is made against you while you are using a shield, you can spend up to 4 stamina points. For that attack, your shield bonus increases by an amount equal to the number of stamina points you spent. This increase does not stack with any gained from the Shield Focus combat trick.
